images.title: Counting stations between
images.purpose: Show the strip from Hauz Khas to Badarpur with the 4 circles between Hauz Khas and Kalkaji Mandir, the capsule at Kalkaji Mandir where the line changes, and the 6 circles between Kalkaji Mandir and Badarpur, so that 4 + 1 + 6 = 11 stations between can be counted.
images.composition: One straight strip across the middle with 13 station marks in a row, the magenta line on the left part and the violet line on the right part, two brackets above and the names and line labels below.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. At the top, centred at x 728 and y 70, the heading From Hauz Khas to Badarpur in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (44 px). STRIP: 13 station marks in one row at y 430, at x 128 plus 100 times the mark number from 0 to 12, so at x 128, 228, 328, 428, 528, 628, 728, 828, 928, 1028, 1128, 1228 and 1328. LINES: a magenta line, one horizontal band 14 px thick (y 423 to 437), x 128 to 628, filled reddish purple #CC79A7 with a thin dark outline (2 px); a violet line, one horizontal band 14 px thick (y 423 to 437), x 628 to 1328, filled violet #6A3D9A with a thin dark outline (2 px). MARKS: mark 0 at x 128 is a capsule (the interchange Hauz Khas), marks 1 to 4 at x 228, 328, 428 and 528 are circles, mark 5 at x 628 is a capsule (the interchange Kalkaji Mandir), marks 6 to 11 at x 728, 828, 928, 1028, 1128 and 1228 are circles, mark 12 at x 1328 is a circle (the end station Badarpur). Every circle has radius 20, white fill and a dark #2B2B2B outline 4 px. Every capsule is a rounded rectangle 90 by 44 px (corner radius 22), white fill, dark outline 4 px, holding two dots of radius 11 at 22 px left and right of its centre: the capsule at x 128 has a yellow #F0E442 dot on the left and a reddish purple #CC79A7 dot on the right; the capsule at x 628 has a reddish purple #CC79A7 dot on the left and a violet #6A3D9A dot on the right. So in all there are 11 circles and 2 capsules. NUMBERS above the circles, dark bold (30 px), centred at y 385: the numbers 1, 2, 3 and 4 above the circles at x 228, 328, 428 and 528; the numbers 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 above the circles at x 728, 828, 928, 1028, 1128 and 1228; no number above the capsules or above the circle at x 1328. BRACKETS: bracket 1, a horizontal dark line (4 px) at y 335 from x 228 to x 528 with a short vertical end of 14 px going down at each end, and above it, centred at x 378 and y 300, the text 4 stations between in dark bold (32 px); bracket 2, a horizontal dark line (4 px) at y 335 from x 728 to x 1228 with a 14 px vertical end going down at each end, and above it, centred at x 978 and y 300, the text 6 stations between in dark bold (32 px). STATION NAMES below the marks, dark bold (30 px), centred at y 500: Hauz Khas at x 128, Kalkaji Mandir at x 628, Badarpur at x 1328. LINE LABELS, dark bold (30 px), centred at y 575: Magenta Line at x 378 and Violet Line at x 978, each with a coloured bar 8 px thick under it at y 600 to 608: a reddish purple #CC79A7 bar from x 148 to x 608 and a violet #6A3D9A bar from x 648 to x 1308. CAPTION centred at x 728 and y 710, dark bold (40 px): 4 + 1 + 6 = 11 stations between Hauz Khas and Badarpur. No other text and nothing else in the frame.
labels: 4 + 1 + 6 = 11 stations between Hauz Khas and Badarpur
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a different number of circles between the two capsules than 4 and 6, or a capsule counted as a circle in the numbers above the circles
any station name other than Hauz Khas, Kalkaji Mandir and Badarpur
images.takeaway: Count the circles between the two ends, count the capsule where you change as one station, and do not count Hauz Khas or Badarpur: 4 + 1 + 6 = 11 stations between.
images.description: A strip of the metro map from Hauz Khas along the magenta line past 4 circles to the Kalkaji Mandir capsule, then along the violet line past 6 circles to Badarpur, with the count 4 + 1 + 6 = 11.
images.context: Concept image for Changing Lines and Counting Stations. It follows the idea of the Delhi metro map in your maths book (lines, circles for stations, capsules for interchanges) and uses this concept's own example, Hauz Khas to Kalkaji Mandir to Badarpur.
images.teaching_notes: Count the numbered circles aloud with the student, then count the capsule as one, then add: 4 + 1 + 6. The slip to watch: counting Hauz Khas or Badarpur, or forgetting the capsule at Kalkaji Mandir.

image_decisions.why: The numbered strip makes the circles between the two ends countable, and shows the capsule counted as one station, which words alone do not.
